name: How does AEO help insurance agents attract new clients?
description: AEO positions insurance agents as an authoritative source, driving traffic and inquiries by providing direct answers to potential clients' search queries.

mainEntity.name: How does AEO help insurance agents attract new clients?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO helps insurance agents attract new clients by positioning them as a go-to source for information. When a potential client searches for specific insurance questions, AEO-optimized content directly provides the answer, often appearing at the top of search results. This increases click-through rates and website traffic, building trust and establishing the agent's authority. By consistently providing valuable answers, agents can convert informational searches into client inquiries and ultimately, new policyholders.
